# Copilot instructions: Nailed It Kitchen

The canonical rules are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read and follow it.
This file is only a pointer for Copilot surfaces that load `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

Non-negotiables, repeated here because they must never be missed:

- Never merge to `main`; a human from CODEOWNERS merges.
- Never put secrets in code, issues, PRs, prompts, or logs.
- Check `guidance/README.md` before a new scope of work.

## References
